```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flowCore)
library(FlowSOM)
library(reshape2)
library(umap)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(cowplot)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
dir<- "Results"
dir.pl <- "Results/plots"
dir.hm <- "Results/heatmaps"

```

#define UMAPS with steady state only WT and IRF
```{r}
head(data)

table(data$file_name)

data$cell_id <- as.character(data$cell_id)

data <- data[, !colnames(data) %in% "file_name"]

table(data$group_id)

data <- data[data$group_id %in% c("WT", "IRF8KO"), ]

#define panel for clustering:
#clustering with CD44, MHCII, CD88, Folr2, Ly6C, CD4, CX3CR1

panel <- colnames(data)
panel_clust <- c("mhcii", "cd44", "cd88", "cd4", "ly6c", "cx3cr1", "forl2")
data_clust  <- data[, c("cell_id", panel_clust)]

setdiff(c("cell_id", panel_clust), names(data))

head(data_clust)

data_input_umap <- data_clust[, !colnames(data_clust) %in% "cell_id"]

data_input_umap <- as.data.frame(lapply(data_input_umap, as.numeric))

data_input_umap <- as.matrix(data_input_umap)
head(data_input_umap)


set.seed(1)

#provide settings here (n_neighbors = 100, min_dist = 0.2, spread=2)
data_umap <-  umap(data_input_umap, n_neighbors = 100, min_dist = 0.2, n_components = 2, metric = "euclidean", spread=2,  verbose =T)

plot(data_umap$layout)

```

```{r}

set.seed(1)
#check for best umap

# Define the parameter sequences
n_neighbors_values <- round(seq(10, 100, length.out = 3))
min_dist_values    <- seq(0.2, 1.9, length.out = 4)

# Open a PDF device to save plots (one plot per page)
pdf("umap_plots.pdf")

# Loop through each combination of parameters
for (nn in n_neighbors_values) {
  for (md in min_dist_values) {
    
    # Try running UMAP with the current parameters
    tryCatch({
      cat("Running UMAP with n_neighbors =", nn, "and min_dist =", md, "\n")
      
      # Run UMAP
      data_umap <- umap(data_input_umap,
                        n_neighbors = nn,
                        min_dist = md,
                        n_components = 2,
                        metric = "euclidean",
                        verbose = TRUE,
                        spread=2)
      
      # Check if the UMAP result has a layout to plot
      if (!is.null(data_umap$layout)) {
        plot(data_umap$layout,
             main = paste("n_neighbors =", nn, ", min_dist =", md),
             xlab = "UMAP1",
             ylab = "UMAP2")
      } else {
        warning("UMAP output did not contain a layout. Skipping this combination.")
      }
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      # If an error occurs, print a message and skip to the next combination
      message("Combination n_neighbors =", nn, "and min_dist =", md, "failed: ", e$message)
    })
  }
}

# Close the PDF device
dev.off()


```

```{r}
#Flowsom
# run FlowSOM (with set.seed for reproducibility, use only data)
# alternatives: set.seed with k=7

set.seed(1)
data_flowsom <- data.matrix(data)
out_fSOM <- ReadInput(flowFrame(exprs = data_flowsom, desc = list(FIL = 1)), transform = FALSE, scale = FALSE, compensate = FALSE)

out_fSOM <- FlowSOM::BuildSOM(out_fSOM, colsToUse = panel_clust)
out_fSOM <- FlowSOM::BuildMST(out_fSOM)
labels <- out_fSOM$map$mapping[,1]
out_meta <- FlowSOM::metaClustering_consensus(out_fSOM$map$codes, k = 7)

meta_results <- data.frame(data)
meta_results <- cbind(meta_results, as.factor(out_meta[labels]))
colnames(meta_results)
table(meta_results$`as.factor(out_meta[labels])`)
colnames(meta_results)[26] <- c("Cluster")

new_columns <- setdiff(colnames(umap_WT_Irf), colnames(meta_results))
umap_data_subset <- umap_WT_Irf[, c("cell_id", new_columns)]
colnames(umap_data_subset)

# Merge the meta_results and umap_data_subset by 'cell_id'
flowsom.meta <- merge(meta_results, umap_data_subset, by = "cell_id")
colnames(flowsom.meta)


```

```{r}
variables <- colnames(flowsom.meta)
variables <- variables[!variables %in% c("cell_id", "sample_id", "Cluster", "UMAP1", "UMAP2", "Ly6G", "group_id", "gate.source", "replicate")]

variables_upper <- toupper(variables)

name_mapping <- setNames(variables_upper, variables)

colnames(flowsom.meta) <- ifelse(colnames(flowsom.meta) %in% variables, toupper(colnames(flowsom.meta)), colnames(flowsom.meta))

flowsom.meta <- flowsom.meta %>%
  rename(FOLR2 = FORL2)

saveRDS(flowsom.meta, paste0(dir, "/umap_cluster_data_WT_IRF.rds"))
```

#stacked barcharts
```{r}
cluster_counts <- flowsom.meta %>%
  group_by(group_id, Cluster) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

# Calculate total counts per genotype and proportions
cluster_counts <- cluster_counts %>%
  group_by(group_id) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(count),
         proportion = count / total) %>%
  ungroup()

# Set the desired order for group_id
cluster_counts$group_id <- factor(cluster_counts$group_id, levels = c("WT", "IRF8KO"))

# Set Cluster as a factor (if not already)
cluster_counts$Cluster <- factor(cluster_counts$Cluster)

ggplot(cluster_counts, aes(x = group_id, y = proportion, fill = Cluster)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("WT" = "WT", "IRF8KO" = bquote(italic(Irf8^"-/-")))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Percentage of Cells", fill = "Cluster", title = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))


ggsave(paste0(dir.pl, "Cluster_proportions.png"), width= 2, height=3, dpi= 600)
```


#statistics for cluster abundance
#1. proptable
```{r}
# Calculate counts per cluster per replicate
cluster_counts <- flowsom.meta %>%
  group_by(replicate, Cluster) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop')

cluster_proportions <- cluster_counts %>%
  group_by(replicate) %>%
  mutate(proportion = (count / sum(count)) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

proportion_table <- cluster_proportions %>%
  select(Cluster, replicate, proportion) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = replicate, values_from = proportion)

# View the proportion table
print(proportion_table)

```

#test cluster 1
```{r}
cluster1 <- proportion_table[proportion_table$Cluster == 1, ]
print(cluster1)

cols_I <- c("I1", "I2", "I3")
cols_W <- c("W1", "W2", "W3")

# Compute group means and standard deviations
values_I <- as.numeric(cluster1[, cols_I])
values_W <- as.numeric(cluster1[, cols_W])
cat("Group I: mean =", mean(values_I), "sd =", sd(values_I), "\n")
cat("Group W: mean =", mean(values_W), "sd =", sd(values_W), "\n")

# Run the t-test manually for cluster1
t_test_res <- t.test(values_I, values_W)
print(t_test_res)
```

```{r}
    mean_percent = mean(proportion_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_percent = sd(proportion_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_percent = sd_percent / sqrt(n_replicates),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

#heatmaps per marker
```{r}
colnames(flowsom.meta)

selected_variables <- c("FOLR2", "CD4",  "CD44", "LY6C", "CD88", "CX3CR1", "MHCII")

# Define the desired order of replicates
desired_replicate_order <- c(
  "W1", "W2", "W3",
  "I1", "I2", "I3")


# Aggregate data: mean of selected variables per Cluster per replicate
aggregated_data <- flowsom.meta %>%
  group_by(replicate, Cluster) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(selected_variables), mean, .names = "mean_{col}"), .groups = 'drop')

# Initialize a list to store matrices for each variable
heatmap_matrices <- list()

for (var in selected_variables) {
  
  # Extract the relevant columns using all_of() to reference the external column name
  data_var <- aggregated_data %>%
    select(replicate, Cluster, all_of(paste0("mean_", var))) %>%
    rename(!!var := !!sym(paste0("mean_", var))) %>%
    arrange(as.numeric(as.character(Cluster)))  # Ensure clusters are ordered numerically
  
  # Pivot the data to wide format: rows=Cluster, columns=replicate
  data_matrix <- data_var %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = replicate, values_from = var) %>%
    arrange(as.numeric(as.character(Cluster)))  # Ensure consistent ordering
  
  # Convert to matrix and set row names
  mat <- as.matrix(data_matrix[,-1])  # Exclude 'Cluster' column
  rownames(mat) <- data_matrix$Cluster
  
  # Store the matrix in the list with the variable name as the key
  heatmap_matrices[[var]] <- mat
}





# Function to reorder columns based on desired order
reorder_columns <- function(mat, desired_order) {
  # Identify replicates present in the matrix
  existing_replicates <- colnames(mat)
  
  # Determine replicates to include (present in both desired_order and matrix)
  replicates_to_include <- intersect(desired_order, existing_replicates)
  
  # Reorder columns based on replicates_to_include
  mat_reordered <- mat[, replicates_to_include, drop = FALSE]
  
  return(mat_reordered)
}

# Apply the reordering to all matrices in the list
heatmap_matrices_ordered <- lapply(heatmap_matrices, reorder_columns, desired_order = desired_replicate_order)



col_fun <- rev(hcl.colors(10, "RdYlBu")) 

# Loop through each variable to create heatmaps
for (var in selected_variables) {
  
  # Retrieve the matrix for the current variable
  mat <- heatmap_matrices_ordered[[var]]
  
  # Create the heatmap object
  ht <- Heatmap(mat,
                name = var,  # Legend title
                col = col_fun,
                cluster_rows = F,    # Cluster rows (clusters)
                cluster_columns = F, # Cluster columns (replicates)
                show_row_names = TRUE,
                show_column_names = TRUE,
                row_names_side = "left",
                column_names_side = "bottom",
                column_title = var,
                heatmap_legend_param = list(title = var))
  
  # Draw the heatmap
  draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right")
  
  # Optional: Save the heatmap to a file
  png(filename = paste0(dir.hm, "Heatmap_", var, ".png"), width = 450, height = 450, res = 150)
  draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right")
  dev.off()
}
```
